page.overview:
Who is Augustus Valian?

King , known simply as Gus by his former war comrades, is the ruler of the Kingdom of Timmony.

Gus is a tall (about 6'4") and muscular man with thick arms and a broad back, the obvious build of a mercenary even years after he became king. He has salt and pepper hair and beard, and scars that include a big one that runs over his left eye and into his cheek (which looks like it should have killed him) and a burn from a fire poker. When the Schemers encountered him in Dol-Makjar, he was wearing a leather vest and a broadsword whose pommel was a snarling dog.

Despite his position as monarch, Augustus remembers his origins and shows a certain level of gratitude and closeness to those who fought alongside him. He is known to favor the commonfolk, and spends time with them when he can, since he doesn't like talking and hearing news exclusively from politicians. To Bolaire Lathalia, he introduced himself as a former soldier who'd now gotten himself involved in politics.

Augustus was born in the nation of Argosia, in the region that would later become his kingdom. There were rumors about him being a bastard, but he was in fact the trueborn son of a noble. Augustus's biological father was a lord of Argosia, whom he described as "a cruel, egotistical tyrant, a monster" who believed he had visions of the shapers after they died. Seemingly fearing for his safety under such a man, the midwife at Augustus's birth got him out of the room and brought him to be raised by the lord's kennel master; during this period of his life he grew very fond of hounds and their loyalty and believed his surname to be "Kennel" for the first eighteen years of his life. However, at some point his true nature was discovered and his adoptive father and uncles were hanged, most likely by order of Augustus's father. In response, Augustus killed his father and took his throne and his title.
